name: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Implement the Deutsch-Jozsa algorithm in Qisk
task_prompt: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Implement the Deutsch-Jozsa algorithm in Qiskit for the constant function f(x) = 1 for all x on 3 input qubits. Print the measurement outcome and the conclusion. Give one complete script that runs end-to-end on its own and prints the outcome.
